pagereader-button-label: Label on the read-aloud button before it starts speaking.
pagereader-button-label-stop: Label on the read-aloud button while it is speaking, to stop it.
pagereader-voice-label: Visually-hidden label for the voice-gender selector next to the read-aloud button.
pagereader-voice-auto: Option in the voice-gender selector: use the browser's default voice (ignores the site's configured gender preference, even if that is set to female or male). Labeled "browser dependent" since which voice this actually produces varies entirely by browser/OS, unlike the client-side Piper option.
pagereader-voice-female: Option in the voice-gender selector: prefer a voice labeled female. Labeled as a Chrome voice since Chrome is the browser most likely to have a real named female voice available; other browsers may fall back to the default voice regardless of this choice.
pagereader-voice-male: Option in the voice-gender selector: prefer a voice labeled male. Labeled as a Chrome voice since Chrome is the browser most likely to have a real named male voice available; other browsers may fall back to the default voice regardless of this choice.
pagereader-voice-piper: Option in the voice selector: switch to the higher-quality client-side Piper voice ("Amy"). Only shown on a WebAssembly/AudioContext-capable browser with the feature enabled.
pagereader-pause-label: Label on the pause button while speech is in progress and not yet paused.
pagereader-pause-label-resume: Label on the pause button while speech is currently paused, to resume it.
pagereader-piper-warning-text: Text shown in the inline warning box under the voice selector when the reader picks the Piper voice option but hasn't downloaded it yet. Explicitly says which voice the main read-aloud button will actually use in the meantime, since the select showing "Amy" otherwise makes it look like clicking read-aloud will already use her. {{doc-important|Approximate size of the en_US-amy-medium Piper voice model in megabytes; update if the pinned voice/version changes.}}
pagereader-piper-download-button: Label on the button inside the inline warning box that starts the Piper voice model download.
pagereader-piper-downloading: Text shown in the inline warning box while the voice model is downloading. Progress percentage is appended by JS, not part of this message.
